title: My Girlfriend Gives Me Goosebumps!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Haruka Kawatsuji survived a childhood fall from his balcony and has felt numb ever since, chasing thrills in sports and horror films. He meets Kisaki Tokano, an eccentric classmate whose obsessive, stalker-like devotion finally gives him the jolt he craves, and he decides to date her. The three-volume romantic comedy-thriller plays her boundary-crossing behavior for both laughs and chills.
life_message: Feeling truly alive may come from an intense, even frightening love that one chooses with open eyes.

folkways.japan: The yandere archetype, a love interest whose devotion turns menacing, is an established Japanese romantic-comedy convention played for genre thrills.

delivery.evidence: Reviewer describes a playful, fond 'freak for freak' romance; no lessons stated (Stitch Media Mix).
delivery.note: The story celebrates the pair's odd bond through situations rather than argument.

winners_losers: Haruka gains the aliveness he wanted and Tokano gains him; ordinary caution loses. Sympathy goes to the unconventional couple.
